name: DFT Functional Benchmark for Pyranoflavylium Cations
description: Assesses various density functional theory functionals for their ability to predict photophysical properties of pyranoflavylium cations.
evaluation_method: MAE / RMSE (e.g., errors in nm or eV)
typical_sota_score: MAE ≈ 0.05–0.30 eV (varies by functional, basis set, and solvent model)
reputation: Specialized benchmark used within computational chemistry for assessing DFT functional performance on pyranoflavylium cations; of interest to spectroscopy and DFT-method developers but not a broadly used community standard.
notes: Small, chemistry-specific dataset; results strongly dependent on choice of basis set, solvent/modeling, and geometry; non-LLM benchmark. Limited chemical diversity may limit generalization.
